$comment: Lane C formula catalog. All paths relative to /home/dawid/dev/specialists. SHAs are git blob SHAs on branch master at audit time.

formulas.name: code-quick
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Hardcoded scrutiny:low label on root; no {{scrutiny}} var (unlike code-standard family). LOW-blast trivial change; operator may implement directly without executor.
formulas.writer_class: none declared — no writer step in formula (canon §3.1 diagram shows optional 'executor or no-writer trivial'; README table matches formula: root → reviewer)
non_canonical_assumptions: bd-specific labels (chain-root, kind:root, role:, edge:, scrutiny:) are materialization hints, not ontology
MANDATE/INPUTS/OUTPUTS/SCOPE/NON_GOALS free-text block inside step description duplicates step-contract semantics as prose

formulas.name: code-standard
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: scrutiny is a pour-time variable rendered into root label + prose; default medium. security-auditor NOT embedded — dispatched separately if sensitive surface (see security-deep).
formulas.writer_class: executor (single writer; HIGH permission implied by canon §2.3, not encoded in formula)
ambidextrous_roles: test-engineer appears here in QA-secondary position, but with NO position: label — position labels exist only in code-with-tests/test-only
non_canonical_assumptions: permission tiers (HIGH executor / LOW gates) live in canon §2.3 and specialist configs, absent from formula
auto-escalation table (canon §2.4) is external dispatcher policy, only referenced in prose
'Iron pipeline applies' phrasing assumes using-specialists skill enforcement outside the artifact

formulas.name: code-with-advisors
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Default high. NOTE: advisor steps have NO needs edges to root and NO explicit ordering among themselves — parallelism is expressed purely via executor needing all three; advisor findings reach executor through channel/discovered-from conventions described in prose, not edges.
formulas.writer_class: executor (reads all three advisor outputs before opening files)
formulas.advisor_class: three parallel pre-impl advisors: explorer, researcher, overthinker (declared only as executor dependencies — no advisor: labels in this file, unlike premortem/triage/release-prep)
non_canonical_assumptions: advisors write findings 'to the chain channel or discovered-from bead' (canon §3.3) — runtime convention absent from the formula graph
researcher is an unconditional need though its INPUTS say '(if dispatched)' — conditional dispatch not expressible in bd formula schema

formulas.name: code-with-tests
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Default high. Canon adds selection matcher applies_when (type task|bug, scrutiny>=high, scope contains production paths) — NOT in formula (bd formula has no applies_when; selection lives in hook/dispatcher config).
formulas.writer_class: dual planned writers: executor then test-engineer (secondary); lease handoff per substrate §6.9.6 asserted in canon, not encoded
ambidextrous_roles: test-engineer × 2 positions instance: secondary-writer mandate text verbatim in step.description ('you are the secondary writer after the executor…')
non_canonical_assumptions: STRUCTURAL DEFECT: obligations-scanner needs security-auditor unconditionally, so an optional:sensitive step sits on the mandatory dependency path — skipping security-auditor breaks the blocks edge; canon describes it as conditional ('if sensitive')
findings_per_writer reviewer attribution required by mandate text but not machine-encoded
lease/worktree semantics assumed from substrate §6.9.6, absent from artifact

formulas.name: debug
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Default medium; canon says raises to high if regression severe (operator-declared) — not encoded. Regression test mandatory via VALIDATION prose.
formulas.writer_class: debugger (non-skippable, labeled non-skippable:true — only debug and restitch carry this marker)
semantic_edge_hints: edge:validates->debugger (entire QA tail validates the debugger's diff)
non_canonical_assumptions: 'do NOT dispatch executor here' orchestration rule and architectural-root-cause escalation to overthinker/planner (canon §3.4 critical orchestration rule) live only in prose
root type:bug maps to bd issue type enum

formulas.name: doc-sync
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared (canon severity floor N/A). No scrutiny label at all — inconsistent with code-* formulas which always carry one.
non_canonical_assumptions: 'Drift-detector pre-script runs before specialist starts' — external hook assumption embedded in prose
hard single-doc-per-chain rule enforced by sync-docs mandatory rules, not by structure

formulas.name: memory-hygiene
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared. CONTRADICTION with canon §3.13 which lists variables `scope` (default all memories) and `dry_run` (default true) — formula has neither.
non_canonical_assumptions: references bd memories store, .xtrm/memory.md layout, bd kv keys-to-forget — Beads/storage specifics that do not belong in a ChainDefinition
'Bulk-export pre-script runs before specialist starts' — external script hook assumed

formulas.name: planning
formulas.writer_class: planner (HIGH planning authority; writes bd issues, not code)
non_canonical_assumptions: planner OUTPUTS are bd create commands with --parent/--deps and change-contract sections — deep Beads-authoring coupling inside a step contract

Canon §3.10 says planner output proposes recommended_template per leaf bead (roadmap D26 Pass-2); formula mandate does not mention recommended_template annotation — gap vs core UPSTREAM-DEPENDENCIES.md capability `planning_recommends_template`
UPSTREAM-DEPENDENCIES expects planner to use bd swarm validate/create + <change-contract> XML — neither present in this formula's mandate

formulas.name: premortem
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared. Root carries scope-empty:code marker.
formulas.advisor_class: overthinker standalone (4-phase CoT: initial analysis → critique → synthesis → distilled recommendation)
non_canonical_assumptions: substrate rev9 REMOVED `decision` as an issue type classifier ('decision removed as it is an outcome not a classifier') — this formula's root type:decision conflicts with substrate issue schema

formulas.name: release-prep
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared; canon claims floor medium.
formulas.advisor_class: changelog-drafter (READ_ONLY bundle synthesis, labeled advisor:pre-impl despite being a sequential predecessor rather than a parallel advisor)
non_canonical_assumptions: MAJOR CONTRADICTION: canon §3.6 says variables prev_tag/next_version and changelog-keeper 'bump version + tag + push'; formula explicitly NON_GOALS 'no version bump; no build; no commit/tag/push/publish — operator handles via /releasing'. Per canon §1 precedence (formula wins for executable shape), the formula is current and canon §3.6 is stale
git tag-range semantics (.xtrm/reports/*.md, xt reports) baked into inputs

formulas.name: research-only
roles: {{specialist}} (explorer|researcher|overthinker per canon; explorer|researcher per formula description)
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared. Only formula whose ROLE ITSELF is templated (`role:{{specialist}}`, title `{{specialist}}:{{root_title}}`).
formulas.writer_class: none (READ_ONLY findings memo to bd notes + optional design doc)
ambidextrous_roles: inverse case: instead of one role in two positions, one position filled by a variable role
non_canonical_assumptions: variable substitution into the role field assumes the pour engine accepts templated roles — a ChainDefinition compiler needs a role-enum constraint or explicit validation here
canon allows overthinker as third specialist choice; formula description mentions only explorer/researcher override

formulas.name: restitch
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: None declared in formula. Canon §3.9: 'Inherits original chain's SCRUTINY' — no inheritance mechanism exists in bd formula vars and none is encodable here.
non_canonical_assumptions: CONTRADICTION: canon §3.9 mermaid shows root → debugger → seconder → reviewer (NO test-engineer/test-runner/obligations); formula ships the full QA tail. README table matches the formula; canon diagram stale
ddiff carry-forward of prior chain's QA evidence (canon) is reducer semantics, not representable in the artifact
canon names variable original_chain_root; formula carries only conflict_source — no structural link back to the failed chain

formulas.name: security-deep
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Default critical. Canonical example of same-role-two-classes: role:security-auditor twice, distinguished by phase:advisor vs phase:gate labels and separate step ids.
formulas.advisor_class: security-auditor as pre-impl threat-model advisor (LOW permission, recommendations-only, CVE/CWE citations requested)
ambidextrous_roles: security-auditor × 2 classes — THE established ambidextrous precedent (substrate same-role-two-classes, §6.2.1)
non_canonical_assumptions: sensitive_surface var named in canon §3.5 (auth|secrets|crypto|migration|hooks|permissions|lockfile|agent-config) is ABSENT from formula vars — only surface:sensitive label
CVE/CWE citation expectation is prompt-level content, not structure

formulas.name: test-only
formulas.scrutiny_assumption: Default medium. No security-auditor/obligations-scanner (matches canon §3.15 rationale). coverage_target named in canon §3.15 vars but ABSENT from formula vars.
formulas.writer_class: test-engineer as PRIMARY writer (mandate text: 'you are the primary writer; write tests that satisfy the bead contract')
semantic_edge_hints: edge:validates->root (writer carries a validates edge — unusual)
non_canonical_assumptions: applies_when matcher (scope_matches test/** etc., no production file) documented in canon §3.15 but not encodable in formula

anomaly: test-only's writer carries edge:validates->root while code-with-tests' equivalent writer carries edge:implements->root — validates/implements usage for the writer→root relation is inconsistent across formulas

formulas.name: triage
formulas.writer_class: none — output is advisory; OPERATOR applies recommendations after the chain (bd dep/duplicate/supersede/close)
formulas.advisor_class: sequential advisors: explorer (clustering/dup/orphan mapping) → overthinker (4-phase critique + ranked recommendations); sequencing via needs edge, both labeled advisor:pre-impl despite being the entire chain
non_canonical_assumptions: deeply Beads-coupled: inputs bd list --json, outputs ready-to-run bd commands — board-domain work expressed as a chain
'orphan tracking-beads (step-beads missing validates edge to root)' presumes THIS system's own edge vocabulary inside a template
